weights_rationale: The offer context focuses on finding operators who 'could send them clients,' so destination_overlap is set to a high positive value (30) to reward leads already selling Portugal. Country weight is kept low (10) because source_markets was flagged as a low-confidence field in the research. High weights are assigned to travel_type and niche_match (15 each) to ensure a tight fit with the prospect's highly specific 'vintage car' and 'luxury wine' boutique positioning.
prospect_summary: Douro Vintage Tours is a boutique Portuguese DMC and tour operator based in Vila Real that specializes in private, high-end day tours of the Douro Valley wine region using vintage and luxury cars. Their core product mix is full-day guided experiences covering wine estate visits and tastings (with named partner quintas including Quinta do Crasto, Quinta da Pacheca, Quinta do Vallado, Quinta do Tedo and others), heritage stops such as Casa de Mateus, gastronomic lunches at quintas, and Douro River boat trips through a sister operation. They run a bilingual Portuguese/English site, serve pickups from both the Douro Valley and Porto, and target affluent leisure travelers, corporate / incentive groups, and wedding parties. Their licensed Turismo de Portugal status (RNAAT 778/2017) plus their boutique positioning makes them a credible DMC partner for inbound wine and luxury Portugal product, although they do not publish a B2B trade page or formal partner roster.
